# ============================================================
# SOCK SHOP - KUBERNETES DEPLOYMENT
# ============================================================
# Application: Weaveworks Sock Shop
# Namespace: sock-shop
#
# Includes:
# - Namespace and resource quotas
# - Database credentials Secret
# - Deployments for application microservices
# - StatefulSets with persistent storage for databases
# - Internal ClusterIP Services
# - External LoadBalancer for edge-router
# - Resource requests and limits
# - Health checks and graceful termination
# - Container security contexts
# - NetworkPolicies
# - Optional suspended load-test Job
#
# IMPORTANT:
# 1. Replace the database password placeholder before applying.
# 2. Configure a production StorageClass and storage backups.
# 3. Configure TLS at the external load balancer.
# 4. These upstream images are deprecated; upgrade and audit
#    them before deploying real production workloads.
# 5. The Docker socket is intentionally not mounted.
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: sock-shop
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: sock-shop
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/audit: restricted
    pod-security.kubernetes.io/warn: restricted

---
# ============================================================
# RESOURCE QUOTA
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: ResourceQuota
metadata:
  name: sock-shop-quota
  namespace: sock-shop
spec:
  hard:
    requests.cpu: "8"
    requests.memory: 12Gi
    limits.cpu: "20"
    limits.memory: 24Gi
    requests.storage: 50Gi
    pods: "60"
    persistentvolumeclaims: "10"

---
# ============================================================
# DATABASE SECRET
# ============================================================
# Replace the placeholder before deployment.
# For real production environments, prefer External Secrets
# backed by an external secret-management system.

apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: catalogue-db-secret
  namespace: sock-shop
type: Opaque
stringData:
  MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: "REPLACE_WITH_STRONG_RANDOM_PASSWORD"

---
# ============================================================
# FRONT-END
# ============================================================

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: front-end
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: front-end
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: front-end
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: front-end
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app: front-end
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
      containers:
        - name: front-end
          image: weaveworksdemos/front-end:0.3.12
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8079
              protocol: TCP
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 10001
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            failureThreshold: 30
            periodSeconds: 10
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: front-end
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: front-end
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: front-end
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: 8079
      protocol: TCP

---
# ============================================================
# EDGE ROUTER
# ============================================================

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: edge-router
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: edge-router
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: edge-router
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: edge-router
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                labelSelector:
                  matchLabels:
                    app: edge-router
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
      containers:
        - name: edge-router
          image: weaveworksdemos/edge-router:0.1.1
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80
            - name: admin
              containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
              add:
                - NET_BIND_SERVICE
                - CHOWN
                - SETGID
                - SETUID
                - DAC_OVERRIDE
          volumeMounts:
            - name: var-run
              mountPath: /var/run
          startupProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 24
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 20
            failureThreshold: 3
      volumes:
        - name: var-run
          emptyDir:
            medium: Memory
            sizeLimit: 64Mi

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: edge-router
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: edge-router
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  externalTrafficPolicy: Cluster
  selector:
    app: edge-router
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: 80
      protocol: TCP

---
# Internal-only administration port.
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: edge-router-admin
  namespace: sock-shop
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: edge-router
  ports:
    - name: admin
      port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080

---
# ============================================================
# CATALOGUE SERVICE
# ============================================================

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: catalogue
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: catalogue
spec:
  replicas: 2
  revisionHistoryLimit: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: catalogue
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: catalogue
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      containers:
        - name: catalogue
          image: weaveworksdemos/catalogue:0.3.5
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command:
            - /app
          args:
            - -port=80
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 100Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 300m
              memory: 256Mi
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 10001
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
              add:
                - NET_BIND_SERVICE
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 30
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /health
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 20
            failureThreshold: 3

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: catalogue
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: catalogue
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: catalogue
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: 80

---
# ============================================================
# CATALOGUE MYSQL DATABASE
# ============================================================

apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: catalogue-db
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: catalogue-db
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: catalogue-db
  ports:
    - name: mysql
      port: 3306
      targetPort: 3306

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: catalogue-db
  namespace: sock-shop
spec:
  serviceName: catalogue-db
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: catalogue-db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: catalogue-db
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      containers:
        - name: catalogue-db
          image: weaveworksdemos/catalogue-db:0.3.0
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: mysql
              containerPort: 3306
          env:
            - name: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: catalogue-db-secret
                  key: MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
            - name: MYSQL_DATABASE
              value: socksdb
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: 1Gi
          volumeMounts:
            - name: mysql-data
              mountPath: /var/lib/mysql
          startupProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: mysql
            failureThreshold: 60
            periodSeconds: 5
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: mysql
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: mysql
            periodSeconds: 20
            failureThreshold: 6
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: mysql-data
      spec:
        accessModes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 10Gi

  name: user-db
  namespace: sock-shop

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: user-db
  namespace: sock-shop
spec:
  serviceName: user-db
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: user-db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: user-db
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      containers:
        - name: user-db
          image: weaveworksdemos/user-db:0.4.0
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: mongo
              containerPort: 27017
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 1Gi
          securityContext:
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
              add:
                - CHOWN
                - SETGID
                - SETUID
          volumeMounts:
            - name: mongo-data
              mountPath: /data/db
            - name: mongo-config
              mountPath: /data/configdb
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
          startupProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: mongo
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 60
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: mongo
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: mongo
            periodSeconds: 20
            failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir:
            medium: Memory
            sizeLimit: 128Mi
        - name: mongo-config
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: 256Mi
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: mongo-data
      spec:
        accessModes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 5Gi

# ============================================================
# USER SIMULATOR - OPTIONAL LOAD TEST
# ============================================================
# Suspended by default to prevent synthetic traffic
# against a production environment.
#
# To enable:
# kubectl patch job user-sim -n sock-shop \
#   --type merge -p '{"spec":{"suspend":false}}'

apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: user-sim
  namespace: sock-shop
  labels:
    app: user-sim
spec:
  suspend: true
  backoffLimit: 1
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 600
  ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 3600
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: user-sim
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      containers:
        - name: user-sim
          image: weaveworksdemos/load-test:0.1.1
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          args:
            - "-d"
            - "60"
            - "-r"
            - "200"
            - "-c"
            - "2"
            - "-h"
            - "edge-router"
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL

  policyTypes:
